patches_added.name: Hide AI Lab Tab
patches_added.description: Removes the third bottom navigation tab ('AI Lab' / 'Lab. IA') by forcing its visibility observer to always hide the tab.

patches_added.name: Hide False Hopes Features
patches_added.description: Hides 'IA ultra HD' (Export Super Resolution) and 'Flusso ottico' (Slow Motion Optical Flow) options since they are cloud-gated.

patches_added.name: Suppress Telemetry and Trackers
patches_added.description: Disables background monitoring and analytics frameworks including ByteDance Helios, AppLog, and AppsFlyer.

patches_added.name: Disable tip notifications
patches_added.description: Suppresses Ozon push notifications asking the user to leave a pickup-point tip.

patches_added.name: Disable background hooks
patches_added.description: Disables RuStore network-state monitoring, built-in VPN sessions, and startup hooks.

patches_added.name: Disable gaming profile
patches_added.description: Removes the Game Profile and usage statistics access, hides both gaming cards, and blocks navigation to the profile.

patches_added.name: Disable invasive permissions
patches_added.description: Removes privileged, phone, SMS, location, storage, billing, USB, and vendor access.

patches_added.name: Disable push services
patches_added.description: Disables RuStore and VK remote push services and background tasks.

patches_added.name: Restore secure-session compatibility
patches_added.description: Preserves RuStore secure-session requests when the APK is re-signed.

patches_added.name: Restrict background work to updates
patches_added.description: Keeps background workers required for update checks, downloads, patching, and installation.

patches_added.name: Skip update authentication
patches_added.description: Skips the VK ID authorization suggestion shown during app installs and updates.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes advertisements and search recommendations, clears advertising identifiers, keeps advertising consent disabled, and removes the unsolicited VK ID prompt, with options for additional interface cleanup.

patches_added.name: Top Toolbar Item Count
patches_added.description:
自訂 Gboard 頂端工具列項目數量
Customize the Gboard top toolbar item count.

patches_added.name: Experimental VRLink unmanaged full space
patches_added.description: 5002322-only permission-free A/B. Adds Android XR's required unmanaged Full Space property directly to VRLink while forwarding OpenXR frames unchanged.

patches_added.name: Experimental XR projection quality settings
patches_added.description: Permission-free A/B. Requests quality supersampling and sharpening on Steam Link projection layers when the enabled runtime extension supports it.

patches_added.name: Experimental XR projection settings stripped
patches_added.description: Permission-free A/B. Removes only known FB projection-settings nodes while preserving all other layer metadata and failing open when unsafe.

patches_added.name: Experimental XR projection trace control
patches_added.description: Read-only permission-free control. Forwards Steam Link frames unchanged while tracing its foveated projection composition.

patches_removed.name: XR projection quality settings
patches_removed.description: Permission-free A/B. Requests quality supersampling and sharpening on Steam Link projection layers when the enabled runtime extension supports it.

patches_removed.name: XR projection settings stripped
patches_removed.description: Permission-free A/B. Removes only known FB projection-settings nodes while preserving all other layer metadata and failing open when unsafe.

patches_removed.name: XR projection trace control
patches_removed.description: Read-only permission-free control. Forwards Steam Link frames unchanged while tracing its foveated projection composition.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Google Play Install Check
patches_modified.description: App always behaves as if installed from Google Play, bypassing the install source check.

patches_modified.name: Watch Ad Instant Reward
patches_modified.description: Pressing "Watch ad" grants +15 min premium instantly without loading ads. (TESTING)

patches_modified.name: Add 'Give Kudos' button to 'Group Activity'
patches_modified.description: Adds a button that triggers the same action as shaking your phone would.

patches_modified.name: Add media download
patches_modified.description: Extends the full-screen media viewer menu with items to copy or open their URLs or download them directly.

patches_modified.name: Add route export
patches_modified.description: Allows exporting and downloading Strava routes as GPX or TCX files directly from the app.

patches_modified.name: Block Snowplow tracking
patches_modified.description: Blocks Snowplow analytics. See https://snowplow.io for more information.

patches_modified.name: Disable Quick Edit
patches_modified.description: Prevents the Quick Edit prompt from popping up.

patches_modified.name: Enable password login
patches_modified.description: Re-enables password login after having used an OTP code.

patches_modified.name: Hide distractions
patches_modified.description: Hides elements that are not essential.

patches_modified.name: Overwrite media upload parameters
patches_modified.description: Overwrites the compression, resize and trim media (images and videos) parameters returned by Strava's server before upload.

patches_added.name: Floating Web Search
patches_added.description:
直接從 Gboard 開啟懸浮網頁，快速搜尋需要的資訊。
Open a floating web page directly from Gboard to quickly search for the information you need.

patches_modified.name: Enable Platinum
patches_modified.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches_modified.name: Toggle feature flags
patches_modified.description: Turn Gboard features on with individual switches. Each switch maps to a Gboard feature flag; flip it on to enable that feature. Unknown or already-default flags are skipped safely.
